# ROS 2 Jazzy Engineering Fails to Link pinocchio::pinocchio When Including Pinocchio 4.0 Header, Results in Boost Variant Template Parameter Compilation Error

> **Current answer:** Do not continue to adjust include order. The original author used ament_target_dependencies(test pinocchio ...) without inheriting Boost compilation definitions from the Pinocchio target; changing to find_package(pinocchio REQUIRED) and using target_link_libraries(test pinocchio::pinocchio) restored compilation. The maintainer confirmed that imported targets automatically propagate four Boost MPL/Fusion upper bound definitions and deemed this the correct solution.

## Key terms

- Imported target (导入目标)
- Compile definition (编译定义)
- Template arity limit (模板参数上限)
- Meta-Programming Library (MPL) (元编程库)

## Problem and symptoms

- How to distinguish between Pinocchio code errors and CMake target usage errors when ROS Jazzy includes Pinocchio 4.0 header files?
- Compilation of a minimal include program results in boost::detail::variant::make_variant_list receiving 25 template parameters, while preprocessed boost::mpl::list provides only 20 parameter positions.
- Adjusting include order, adding pinocchio/fwd.hpp, or trying other Pinocchio header files does not resolve the error.

## Environment

- Ubuntu 24.04; ROS 2 Jazzy; installed via rosdep/apt on ros-jazzy-pinocchio; Pinocchio 4.0.0; Boost 1.83; colcon, ament_cmake.

## Priority diagnostics

- Check if CMake actually links the pinocchio::pinocchio target, not just passing the package name to ament_target_dependencies or manually adding include paths.
- If CMake target is not usable, the maintainer's diagnostic clues involve verifying BOOST_FUSION_INVOKE_MAX_ARITY=12, BOOST_MPL_CFG_NO_PREPROCESSED_HEADERS, BOOST_MPL_LIMIT_LIST_SIZE=30, and BOOST_MPL_LIMIT_VECTOR_SIZE=30.

## Possible causes

- The author's old CMakeLists used ament_target_dependencies(test pinocchio urdfdom_headers), not linking imported targets as per Pinocchio project standards, so the target did not inherit required Boost compilation definitions.

## Attempts

- Author modified the dependency section to find_package(pinocchio REQUIRED) and target_link_libraries(test pinocchio::pinocchio), removing old manual Eigen include/ament dependency writing.

## Effective fixes

- Link pinocchio::pinocchio on the target to automatically propagate required Boost compilation definitions; the original poster reported successful compilation after the change.

## Result

- The author confirmed the target_link_libraries approach is usable; the maintainer stated imported targets automatically propagate the above definitions and confirmed this is the correct solution; Issue closed.

## Limitations

- This record directly covers ROS Jazzy, Pinocchio 4.0.0, and Boost 1.83; other distributions' Boost templates still need comparison.
- The maintainer provided a manual -D definition as a fallback when CMake target is not usable, but the original thread validated the imported target approach.

## Safety notes

- Control software builds should propagate Pinocchio target compilation definitions as auditable dependencies to prevent inconsistent builds from manual include/define assembly.
